title: bee dispatch wave: prepare every ready cell of the current wave in one call
action: Add bee dispatch wave (--runtime required, --json): compute the current schedule wave (reuse cells schedule logic), take every ready unclaimed cell in it, and for each run the same claim+reserve+payload path dispatch prepare --kind cell uses, with an auto worker name derived from the cell id. Output {wave:[payloads], skipped:[{id,reason}], economics[]} — one refusal never poisons the batch: a cell that refuses (claimed elsewhere, reservation conflict) lands in skipped with the typed reason and the rest proceed. Registry/help registration follows sibling commands (bee dev regen now exists for the generated registry). Tests: two disjoint ready cells return two payloads, a foreign-claimed cell lands in skipped with reason, empty wave returns empty arrays.

truths: Partial refusal never aborts the whole wave
Each payload equals what per-cell prepare would emit
Claim and reservation semantics identical to per-cell path
